items.title: Short-term headwind? Yes. But the structure stays intact: 5 large-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 19%
items.description: Wise men on the street will tell you it is foolish to try and time the market. And attempting to do so in the midst of a raging war is probably even more foolhardy. But even in these uncertain times, there is something that can be said with certainty: This war will also end. So, think beyond war, even as it rages on. Think of the structural stories that are changing some sectors.

items.title: Weekly Market Outlook: Can Nifty find its footing as crude, Fed policy drive markets?
items.description: Indian equities enter a holiday-shortened week with the Nifty at a crucial support zone after five consecutive weekly declines. The US Fed’s policy decision, FOMC projections, crude oil prices, global bond yields and foreign flows will drive near-term sentiment. Analysts expect volatility to remain elevated but see scope for buying at lower levels, with the Nifty’s 23,000–23,300 zone in focus.

items.title: EV-related stocks: Own the chain, not the guess; 13 stocks with upside potential of up to 28% and downside risk of -14%, according to analysts
items.description: In the stock market, when a big theme or sectoral trend takes off, most investors focus on the face of it. A brand with which they can relate. The same is happening in the auto sector, which is transitioning to the EV age. However, behind every EV is a long, hidden chain of businesses. Chasing an obvious name means betting on just one stock. There is a better way.
